## Protocol

From `packages/protocol/src/index.ts` exported constants, not from route source.

| Constant | Value | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PROTOCOL_VERSION` | 2 | OAuth, Device control, Account metadata, catalogs |
| `MANAGED_DATA_PROTOCOL_VERSION` | 6 | Quota, Usage, and Account summary |

JSON Schemas in `packages/protocol/schema/` (published under `/schema/`):

- [`account-http.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/account-http.json) — Quota account HTTP payloads `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/account-http.json`
- [`local-usage.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/local-usage.json) — Quota local Usage report `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/local-usage.json`
- [`model-catalog-v1.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/model-catalog-v1.json) — Quota report-time model catalog v2 `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/model-catalog-v1.json`
- [`pricing-catalog-v2.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/pricing-catalog-v2.json) — Quota pricing catalog v2 `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/pricing-catalog-v2.json`
- [`quota-collection-report.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/quota-collection-report.json) — Quota local collection report `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/quota-collection-report.json`
- [`quota-snapshot.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/quota-snapshot.json) — Quota snapshot upload `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/quota-snapshot.json`
- [`usage.json`](../packages/protocol/schema/usage.json) — Quota Usage payloads `https://quota.gotry.io/schema/usage.json`

This list is not an HTTP route catalog. Routes are defined by those schemas and exercised by
the Relay tests under [`apps/relay/test/`](../apps/relay/test/) and the wire cases in
[`packages/protocol/fixtures/wire-conformance.json`](../packages/protocol/fixtures/wire-conformance.json).
